narrative.overview: ParkFlow feels like walking through a well-run premium parking facility at night: legible signage, visible machinery and exact status signals. B3 and B4 deliberately switch to a white investment-memo mode with dark ink, cool grey rules and flat financial surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Cinematic entrance, operational detail, white business appendix.
Evidence, assumptions and hypotheses are separated.
Member gold is rare; a darker case gold is used on white.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red and violet communicate status; never use them as arbitrary decoration.

rules.name: The Answer-First Rule
rules.body: Headlines state the decision or outcome; explanatory prose follows.

rules.name: The Physical Depth Rule
rules.body: If an element does not plausibly float in the car-park world, it receives no drop shadow.

dos: Do make the member guarantee legible before discussing forecasting.
Do distinguish measured evidence, planning assumptions and hypotheses.
Do switch B3 and B4 to white investment-memo mode with flat panels and cool grey rules.
Do use direct B3 and B4 headings, with the argument in a smaller subtitle.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS landing-page clichés.
Don't conflate deterministic control with probabilistic forecasting.
Don't use excessive animation in financial and go-to-market sections.
Don't use conclusion-style slogans as the main heading on commercial slides.
